title: Stock market: Which are top gainers and losers on NSE & BSE today? Check list
summary: Stock markets experienced a significant rebound on Wednesday, with the Sensex and Nifty surging past key levels. This rally was fueled by a sharp decline in crude oil prices, robust buying in banking and IT sectors, and growing optimism surrounding a potential India-US trade agreement.
